items.title: Jones Hank — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Wasn’t that drummer Shadow? I mean Kluk, rather.

ctx.x: When you did that date, do you reflect upon the previous recordings you did with him at Savoy?
You mean, "Spontaneous Combustion," and all that stuff? Well, his brother was on that date. Wasn’t that drummer Shadow? I mean Kluk, rather.
